gen-gf-autour-one-gf-cal-sans: Expressive and bold, Autour One lays a clear channel into every round letter, while Cal Sans runs one stroke width throughout. Autour One makes the statement; Cal Sans carries the talking.
gen-gf-autour-one-gf-carlito: Carlito reads clearly at small sizes, with open round letters and spacing pulled tight like thread on a spool. And Autour One's unmodulated line across every glyph is the standout, bold where Carlito stays modest.
gen-gf-autour-one-gf-changa: Changa reads sturdy and clean, its lowercase carrying the stature of cast iron capitals. Autour One adds strokes as plain as a stitched thread outline, and that bold simplicity is what holds the two together.
gen-gf-autour-one-gf-courier-prime: Precise and structured, Courier Prime is a monospace with a drafting-pen line and generous mouths on its round letters. Give Autour One the larger size and let Courier Prime stay modest.
gen-gf-autour-one-gf-days-one: Autour One draws every glyph with a single-width stroke. It earns its keep big and brief, while Days One, a sans with an x-height that fills the line, handles the rest.
gen-gf-autour-one-gf-epunda-sans: Epunda Sans opens its e and a counters wide, with curves full of daylight and sidebearings trimmed thin. Shrink Autour One and its rolling-ball-pen line loses its punch.
gen-gf-autour-one-gf-farro: A clear channel leads into each round letter of Autour One. Farro, a sans with compressed ascenders and no stroke contrast, keeps things steady under that bold display voice.
gen-gf-autour-one-gf-fragment-mono: Autour One has no hairline-to-stem shift anywhere in its letters. It does the loud work in display sizes, while Fragment Mono, a monospace with a tall waist line, handles the quiet precision.
gen-gf-autour-one-gf-geist-mono: Geist Mono is a monospace of fixed-width, code-style letters with big side gaps and a high-rising lowercase. Geist Mono does the quiet, structured work, leaving Autour One to be bold and expressive up top.
gen-gf-autour-one-gf-genos: Genos packs its glyphs so close their edges almost kiss, with a high-set midline. And Autour One handles display with flat, contrast-free letters, while Genos adds a soft cadence of fuller stems and slimmer links.
